....[FIRST MINUTE NOT AUDIBLE]... For some reason, my mother went to Boston to work, I think, during that time, for a private family or something. And my father was a steward on a ship at that time. And they met. And so, I was conceived in Boston, but afterwards they married, of course -- they had to be very up to par. Anyway, my mother went to Virginia and I had me, and two months later they took me back to Boston, and after that back to Virginia. I remember staying in Virginia until I was about 3, and then we…
